title: Three explainer styles (high-energy, default demo, engaging one-take)
what_it_does: Skill briefs for a 12-20 s hype promo, a 45-90 s calm product demo and a 10-30 s one-take story with a hero element travelling through stations.
when_to_use: Product explainers; one-take story is the interesting one.
why: Render pipeline is their own, not HyperFrames. The structure (brief, beat map, stations on one canvas) is worth reimplementing as a HyperFrames recipe.
